justification: The only real correspondence is the presence of circular/ring forms — the large open circles and small cup-marks in A versus the concentric rings and central boss of B — which is a near-universal motif. A depicts a narrative scene of schematic human figures with weapons or staffs, a large horned quadruped and a rider, arranged loosely across an open field, whereas B is a strictly radially symmetric, toothed disc with abstract cut-out and relief ornament and no figures or scene at all.
